goal: Automatically check Windows code signing certificates for expiration and revocation in CI
Prevent unexpected release delays from expired certificates during urgent or off-schedule releases
agreement: Substantive support for automating certificate tracking instead of relying on manual checks (fanquake)
Objection that CRL check fails OpenSSL response limit addressed with a separate download fix (hebasto)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it automates certificate monitoring to avoid release-blocking delays for point releases
P3 because it helps maintainers catch expired or revoked Windows signing certs proactively
